description: ASHRAE Standard 223P is a proposed standard, Semantic Data Model for Analytics and Automation Applications in Buildings, being developed by an ASHRAE project committee. The open223 documentation site, developed with the committee but not an official ASHRAE product, explains its purpose and scope, definitions and concepts, graph structure, closed-world assumption, heat transfer equipment, medium mixtures, sensors and properties, with tutorials on model exploration and inference and on creating models with BuildingMOTIF, and guides on design patterns and on using 223 with QUDT, Brick and RealEstateCore. Coverage: building systems generally. Access: the documentation site; the site states that the proposed standard is not yet available for public review. Licence: not stated on the page read; the documentation is free. Caveats: the standard is still a proposal and may change. Simulation uses are a formal, connection-level model of building systems that analytics, control sequences and digital twins can reason over. Related records: Brick Schema and RealEstateCore.
